items.text: thoda aur time chahiye
haan ji thik hai
kal tak kar dunga
do din aur chahiye

items.context: Kya aap poora amount ek saath pay kar sakte hain?
items.text: split kar sakte hain
haan haan theek hai
kal tak payment karne ki koshish karunga
matlab agar thoda aur time mil jaye toh acha rahega
woh main paise kal transfer kar dunga
thoda sa aur time mil sakta hai kya payment ke liye
aisa karte hain ki main half payment abhi aur baaki kal kar dunga
haan ji mujhe Thursday tak extension mil sakta hai kya
mera account mein thoda dikkat aa gayi hai paise ke transfer mein

items.context: Kya aapko payment ke liye extension chahiye?
items.text: mera thoda time chahiye extension ke liye please

items.context: Kya aap poore amount ka hisaab baant ke payment karna chahenge?
items.text: main payment split karna chahta hu kya ho sakta hai

items.context: Kya aapko aur samanay ki zarurat hai?
items.text: arre haan matlab thoda aur samay chahiye mujhe
mera payment agle Wednesday ko ho jayega

items.context: Kya aapko payment karne mein der hogi?
items.text: main kal tak poora amount nahi kar paaunga thoda sa delay hoga
main thoda payment aaj kar dunga aur baaki kuch dino mein karna chahunga kya ye acceptable hai
meri situation thodi tight hai isliye main paise do installments mein dena chahta hu kya ho sakta hai
main 15 tareekh tak paise jama kar dunga abhi thoda financial issue chal raha hai ghar mein

items.context: Kya aapko payment mein extension chahiye?
items.text: maa ji thoda aur waqt chahiye kyuki salary late aayi thi isliye payment abhi nahi kar paunga

items.context: Kya aap payment ko split karna chahenge?
items.text: payment apne do hisso mein karna chahunga pehla hissaa kal aur doosra do din baad kar dunga if possible

items.context: Kitne din ka extension chahiye aapko payment ke liye?
items.text: thoda aur samay mil sakta hai kya main 20 tareekh tak amount clear kar dunga apna account

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: collections
Intent: ask_extension - asks for more time or to split the payment
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with fillers and hesitations (umm, matlab, woh, accha, haan ji); at least a third include a self-correction ('Tuesday, nahi, Wednesday')

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
